messages:
jen_devex: heads-up — got an escalated support ticket: customer reports intermittent 401s + huge billing spike after our client regen earlier today. they say retries doubled requests. :grimacing:

sam_sdk: link to the ticket? any repro steps?

nora_support: https://support.internal/t/9832 — attached logs show a flurry of POST /v1/generate calls with identical payloads, ~2x expected. they blamed SDK update to 0.20.0 but still repros on pinned 0.19.2 in some envs.

jen_devex: minimal repro from support:
```bash
# run once, then simulate flaky 401 from auth service
python examples/gen_repeat.py --n 10 --client-version 0.20.0
```
logs show client retried on 401s and backend charged each attempt.

sam_sdk: hmm. 401 should trigger auth refresh not full retry of the request body. which generator created the client? openapi-generator v6.6 with our regen script.

alex_api: we pushed an OpenAPI tweak earlier: moved securitySchemes: bearerAuth -> name: Authorization, inlined as header param for some operations to support legacy proxies. That might cause generator to emit an extra header param and change retry logic mapping.

mike_sre: confirm latency/throughput note: the spike coincided with regen rollout at 11:04 UTC and our billing hours show per-token unit count doubled for that customer window (11:05–11:20). system logs show many 401->retry loops from same client IP.

sam_sdk: I ran client-gen locally against the updated spec — the TS/Go/Python templates now include an optional `authorization` function param in per-operation args. in python it gets converted into header and also into auth callback fallback. Looks like our generic retry middleware treats missing auth as transient and retries the whole call.

jen_devex: support says they saw both duplicated Authorization headers and retries even when header was present. possible double-auth header caused backend to reject -> client assumed transient -> retried.

nora_support: customer: "we updated to the new SDK because changelog said 'minor client gen fixes' — no mention of auth header changes or behavior regressions." they're upset about surprise billing.

sam_sdk: short-term mitigation: add a compatibility shim in the regen templates to not generate per-operation auth header param, and instead keep global auth like before. I can open a quick PR to the codegen templates.

alex_api: also want to revert the OpenAPI change that inlined the header param — that was the root cause. I'll open a spec patch and tag regen CI to skip until template patch lands.

mike_sre: operationally, we should also add a circuit-breaker in our API that detects repeated 401 retries from the same client and short-circuits with a single 401->401_no_retry response to avoid billing storms. can we do that quickly?

sam_sdk: yes, but that touches runtime. short term I'll add a config flag to the SDK to not auto-retry on 401s unless explicitly enabled (default off). PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/558 :eyes:

jen_devex: repro steps I added to the ticket: 1) regen clients from spec X commit sha abc123 2) run example with mocked auth service returning 401 on first request then 200 on refresh 3) observe duplicated Authorization header and 2x requests. pasted sample Python snippet below:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key='sk-test', version='0.20.0')
for i in range(5):
    try:
        resp = client.generate('hello')
    except Exception as e:
        print('err', e)
```

nora_support: I've informed the customer we'll pause recommending 0.20.0, asked them to pin 0.19.2 and to disable SDK retries via env var REDWOOD_RETRY_ON_401=false while we patch.

sam_sdk: action items: (1) rollback spec header inline (alex), (2) quick template patch to restore old auth surface (sam), (3) PR to add opt-out retry flag and publish hotfix package (sam), (4) CI: add regen test to detect auth header changes and enforce changelog note (jen), (5) add rate-limiter/circuit in gateway to mitigate billing spikes (mike).

alex_api: will open spec revert PR in 15m and add a note to changelog template to explicitly call out security scheme changes.

mike_sre: I'll put a temporary rule on the gateway to cap repeated same-body requests from a single src IP for 5m to protect billing.

jen_devex: CI drift note: our regen job didn't flag this because there isn't a test for securitySchemes renames — I'll add a unit check that compares securitySchemes identity across specs and fails the regen CI on mismatch. will follow up with a small PR.

ci-bot: deploybot: CI pipeline queued for branches: sam/sdk-auth-shim, alex/spec-revert. Estimated time: 20m.

nora_support: customer accepted pin to 0.19.2 and env var config for now. still want credit for unexpected billing; escalated to finance. :pray:

sam_sdk: once template PR merges I'll trigger a full regen and publish 0.20.1 with patch notes. will include explicit changelog entry: "security scheme surface changed — check client auth usage".

jen_devex: thanks all. please paste PR links into the ticket and mark the incident type so we can track as "regen-induced billing spike". i'll follow up with the customer postmortem once fixes are live. :thumbsup:
